#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

name: search_repo
read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue occurs because the PASSWORD reset email link uses the environment variable PUBLIC_URL, which defaults to "http://localhost:3000" if not set. This leads to the reset link pointing to localhost in the email. The fix is to ensure that the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is properly set to the production server's base URL during deployment so the email contains the correct link.
